Analyst.conditioning: Parent S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY, region F_b011_s030__reference, operator pointwise, representation bridge, window [0.1,0.5], controller unit_rms, dose native_rms_ratio 0.66, max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0. The proposed intervention keeps the parent operator (pointwise) and changes only the region to F_b011_s030__NC, so the comparison is a single-factor region swap against the matched parent control response. The NC regional trajectory fits are retrospective pocket-fixed fields over the complete learning window [0.0,0.5] and are not the current gradient-guided parent run; they are used only to motivate the local support, not as a spatial reward gradient.
Analyst.contrast_definition: Same parent program and same operator (pointwise), region F_b011_s030__NC versus region F_b011_s030__reference. The matched control is the S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY response recorded under F_b011_s030__reference/control_response (40 active updates, 40 nonzero, mean point_rms_A 0.169, mean target_error 0.169, no clipping, assignment_switch_fraction mean 0.0020). The NC arm is the R02 local_intervention record under F_b011_s030__NC (n=6, mean_all_pic50 8.018, best_qualified_pic50 8.265, U_tau 0.0430, hit_fraction 0.333, n_qualified 4). These are descriptive pools, not search-adjusted and not target generalization.
Analyst.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under the NC region with the parent pointwise operator and matched dose/controller, the measured execution response shows no localized nonzero updates in the NC support, or shows atom clipping or assignment_switch_fraction above the parent mean 0.0020, or if the terminal pool does not differ from the matched parent control pool in the direction of the observed R02 NC record (mean_all_pic50 8.018, best_qualified_pic50 8.265, U_tau 0.0430) beyond the descriptive paired intervals already reported. A result in which the NC arm matches the reference arm within those intervals, or in which the NC regional trajectory contrast rates (signed_dx_A -0.141, signed_dz_A -0.410, spatial_mass +0.0069) are not reproduced as an execution response, would also falsify the claim that the region swap is the operative factor.

Analyst.predicted_terminal_response: Conditional on the execution response above, expect the NC arm terminal pool to remain in the neighborhood of the observed R02 NC record (n=6, mean_all_pic50 8.018, best_qualified_pic50 8.265, U_tau 0.0430, hit_fraction 0.333, n_qualified 4) and to be compared against the matched parent control pool (n=24, mean_all_pic50 7.827, best_qualified_pic50 8.434, U_tau 0.0125, hit_fraction 0.042, n_qualified 22). The target best is 8.704806; the parent has n_above_target 0. Analyst.scientific_hypothesis: Restricting the local pointwise coordinate intervention to the NC region (F_b011_s030__NC) rather than the reference region changes the retained local geometry and the terminal affinity distribution relative to the matched parent control. The NC regional trajectory fits show a signed_dx_A contrast net rate of -0.141 A per window versus an ancestor net rate of -0.388 A, and a signed_dz_A contrast net rate of -0.410 A versus ancestor -0.761 A, i.e. the NC contrast field moves less in x and z than the ancestor field; spatial_mass contrast net rate is +0.0069 versus ancestor +0.0754. The hypothesis is that this smaller, region-localized displacement is the actionable observable, and that the NC arm's observed terminal pool (mean_all_pic50 8.018, best_qualified_pic50 8.265, U_tau 0.0430) is a conditional response to that region change rather than to a change in operator, dose, or controller.

Designer.falsifier: Execution-level: the hypothesis is falsified if, under the NC region with the parent pointwise operator and matched dose/controller, the measured current-program response shows no localized nonzero updates in the NC support, or shows atom_clip_fraction above 0.0, or assignment_switch_fraction above the parent mean 0.0020, or injected_rms_A_mean/requested_rms_A_mean above the parent reference mean 0.0301 A. Terminal consequence: conditional on a valid execution response, the NC arm terminal pool is compared against the matched parent control pool (n=24, mean_all_pic50 7.827, best_qualified_pic50 8.434, U_tau 0.0125, hit_fraction 0.042, n_qualified 22); if the NC arm matches the reference arm within the descriptive paired intervals already reported, or if the NC regional trajectory contrast rates (signed_dx_A -0.141, signed_dz_A -0.410, spatial_mass +0.0069) are not reproduced as an execution response, the claim that the region swap is the operative factor is falsified. Improved similarity or lower loss alone cannot establish affinity improvement; affinity is evaluated first with structural and energy side effects reported using the frozen definitions.
